one_sentence: Boivin and Ng (2006, Journal of Econometrics) show that adding more series to a factor model does not always improve the estimated factors' usefulness for forecasting, especially when idiosyncratic errors are cross-correlated or a factor dominant in a small panel becomes dominated in a larger one.

No field mixing detected — this is not a case of one paper's title paired with another's metadata.

The entry has no DOI field. Confirmed via an independent CrossRef bibliographic-query search (not a guessed DOI) that this DOI resolves to exactly this title/authors/volume/issue/pages. Added for a canonical, unambiguous anchor.
BibTeX hygiene: a single hyphen in a page range renders as a hyphen, not an en dash; the convention (and what BibTeX/biblatex expects) is a double hyphen '--' so it typesets as an en dash.
